reference.name: sonoglore_convnext_tiny_grn_eca_asymproj_posw17
reference.notes: current strongest external single-model SonoGloReNet reference

diagnosis.initial_bug_found: Earlier fold1-only weight CSV covered validation samples only, so fold1 training had zero overlap with weighted samples.
diagnosis.fix: Added OOF-wide weight builder and train-side sample_weight_hit_count guard; training now fails if configured sample weights hit zero train samples.
diagnosis.interpretation: OOF malignant-FN reweighting worsened internal ranking and did not preserve external BUSI AUC. The main issue is still benign false-positive inflation and calibration/generalization, not simple malignant hard-case underweighting.

next_recommendation: Stop this FN-only weighting line. Prioritize calibration / threshold-shape / benign-FP suppression directions.
